title: Crunchy Tandoori Chicken with Homemade Minty Coleslaw
ingredients: 8 skinless chicken thigh fillets, excess fat trimmed
Coleslaw: ½ red cabbage (finely shredded), 2 carrots (peeled, julienned or grated), 3 spring onions (sliced diagonally), juice of 1 lemon, handful of mint leaves (~15g, shredded), salt and pepper
steps: Stir curry powder and a pinch of salt into yogurt; add chicken; coat all over. Cover and marinate at least 30 minutes.
Crush cornflakes to fine crumbs in a food processor or food bag.
Spray a lined baking tray with cooking spray.
Remove each chicken piece; shake off excess yogurt; dip in cornflake crumbs until well coated.
Place on tray; spray generously; bake 25 minutes (check at 20 minutes).
Make coleslaw: toss all ingredients together; season.
Chicken is ready when golden and crisp outside with juices running clear.
notes: Coat a whole chicken in the same marinade before roasting for a new twist on a Sunday roast.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
